language_prompt: 🌐 Bot language Current: {current} Pick a language below. (Full localization is in progress — some messages will stay Ukrainian for now.)
lang_confirm_prompt: 👋 Hi! I'm KusWise — your calorie tracker. I'll talk to you in English (detected from your Telegram). If you'd prefer Ukrainian, you can switch below.
onboarding.intro:
👋 Hi! I'm KusWise Bot — your personal nutrition genie.

To calculate your ideal calorie target I need to learn a little about you. Six quick questions, takes about a minute. Ready? 🚀
onboarding.ask_age: 1/6 🎂 How old are you? Just the number (10–100). I won't tell anyone.
onboarding.ask_sex: 2/6 🚻 Sex? Needed for the formula — different metabolism.
onboarding.ask_weight: 3/6 ⚖️ How much do you weigh? (in kilograms) Decimals OK (e.g. 75.5). Scales don't lie. Neither does the bot.
onboarding.ask_height: 4/6 📏 How tall are you? (in centimeters) Whole number, 100–250. Don't add 'with shoes'.
onboarding.ask_gym: 5/6 🏋️ How often do you train per week? Be honest. Couch doesn't count.
onboarding.invalid_number: Hmm, that doesn't look like a number. Try again. 🙂
onboarding.age_range: Age should be between 10 and 100. Try again, please. 🎂
onboarding.weight_range: Weight should be between 30 and 300 kg. Try again. ⚖️
onboarding.height_range: Height should be between 100 and 250 cm. Try again. 📏
onboarding.custom_cal_prompt: Enter your own calorie target (whole number, 1000–6000):
onboarding.custom_cal_range: Calories should be between 1000 and 6000. Try again. 🙂
onboarding.done: 🎉 All set, {name}! I know everything I need now. Send me 📸 a meal photo or 📝 a text description — I'll count it. Commands are in the «/» menu, your profile is at /profile.
onboarding.required: Let's get to know each other first 👋 Tap /start — I'll ask a few questions and calculate your target.
onboarding.ask_tz: 🌐 What's your timezone? This sets when your day rolls over and when the daily summary fires. If your zone isn't in the list, pick «Other» and type the IANA name.
onboarding.tz_custom_prompt: Enter your timezone in IANA format, e.g.: Asia/Tokyo, America/Chicago, Australia/Sydney. Full list: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones
onboarding.tz_invalid: Didn't recognize that zone 🤔 Check the spelling — it should be Region/City, like Europe/Madrid or Asia/Tokyo.
help.full: 🤖 Commands /start — welcome + menu /profile — your profile (editable) /ask — 💬 ask AI about food, recipes, shopping /today — today's progress /yesterday — yesterday's recap /streak — 🔥 logging streak + freeze tokens /goals — 🎯 goals + projected target date /aliases — 📚 dishes the bot learned for you /scan — 🔢 barcode scanner (Open Food Facts) /menu — 📋 restaurant menu OCR /plan — 🗓 3-day meal plan tailored to your goal /recap — 📸 weekly PNG share card /meals — meal list (delete / edit) /fav — ⭐ favorite meals /recent — 🕘 recent meals (quick re-log) /water — 💧 water tracking /suggest_meal — meal idea that fits the day /help — show this list 📸 Send a meal photo — I'll ask which meal it is and show the analysis for review. 📝 Or send text (e.g. «chicken 200g, rice 150g, broccoli 100g»). 🎙 Voice message — say what you ate, I'll transcribe and log it. After analysis: ✅ Accept / 🔄 Recalculate / ✏️ Manual entry.
streak.summary_empty: No streak yet — log your first meal and let's go! 🚀 Your streak grows when you log at least one meal each day. 3 «freeze» tokens per month cover one missed day.
streak.summary_freeze_note: Freezes refill on the 1st of every month.
goals.no_profile: Onboarding not finished yet. Tap /start — I'll ask a few questions, then /goals will show your plan.
goals.no_target: Target weight not set. Set it via /profile → 🏁 Target weight.
goals.projection_at_target: 🎉 You're already at your target weight! Keep the pace.
goals.projection_zero_delta: Weekly delta is 0 — set a target via /goals → 📈 Weekly target.
goals.projection_wrong_direction: Weekly delta points the wrong way — e.g. goal «lose» but a positive delta. Fix via /goals → 📈 Weekly target.
goals.no_current_weight: ⚖️ Current weight not set. Log it via /profile.
goals.projection_line.ahead: 🟢 Ahead of plan — projected target: {date} (~{weeks} weeks)
goals.weekly_ask_lose: 📈 How many kg per week do you want to lose? Write a number — e.g. 0.5 (slow) or 1 (aggressive). Safe range for most people: 0.3-1.0 kg/week.
goals.weekly_ask_gain: 📈 How many kg per week do you want to gain? Write a number — e.g. 0.3 (lean muscle) or 0.5 (with some fat). Safe range: 0.2-0.5 kg/week.
goals.weekly_invalid: Weekly delta should be between 0.1 and 2 kg. Try again 🙂
goals.weekly_wrong_sign: Sign doesn't match your goal. Write a positive number — I'll add the minus for «lose» or plus for «gain».
goals.weekly_not_for_maintain: Weekly delta isn't needed for the «Maintain weight» goal — skipping.
aliases.empty: Nothing logged yet. The bot learns from accepted meals — next time you log «chicken breast», it'll remember your usual portion. Helps guess grams more accurately after ~5 repeats of the same dish.
aliases.intro: The bot uses these usual portions to estimate photos more accurately.
timezone.prompt: 🌐 Timezone Current: {current} Pick a new zone from the list, or «Other» to type one manually.
timezone.not_onboarded: First go through /start to set up your profile ☺️
timezone.custom_prompt: Enter a zone name in IANA format (Region/City), e.g. Asia/Tokyo. /cancel to abort.
health.header: ⚕️ Health 🥜 Allergens: {allergens} 🩺 Conditions: {conditions} This influences meal-analysis warnings (allergen_flags / crohn_flags). Use the buttons below to edit.
health.allergens_prompt: 🥜 Allergens List comma-separated. I recognize: peanut, tree_nut, dairy, egg, soy, gluten, fish, shellfish, sesame, mustard, sulphites, celery, lupin, mollusks Write none to clear, /cancel to abort.
health.conditions_prompt: 🩺 Chronic conditions List comma-separated. I recognize: crohns, ibs, celiac, diabetes_t1, diabetes_t2, hypertension, pcos, kidney, thyroid, gestational Write none to clear, /cancel to abort.
health.saved_with_hints: ✅ Saved: {saved} Didn't recognize: {unknown} — try the canonical list.
health.invalid_all: Didn't recognize any value. Try again or /cancel.
barcode.scan_intro: 📷 Barcode scanner Tap «Open scanner» to launch the camera inside Telegram. Aim at a barcode — I'll find the product on Open Food Facts (3M+ items). Camera not opening? Tap «Type digits» and just type the digits below the barcode (8-13 digits).
barcode.not_found: 🤷 Didn't find barcode {ean} in the database. Try typing the product (e.g. «plain yogurt 150g»), or just photograph it — I'll analyze visually.
barcode.lookup_failed: ❌ Couldn't reach the product database. Try again or type the product manually.
barcode.grams_invalid: Amount should be a number between 1 and 5000 g. Try again 🙂
barcode.pending_expired: Scanned item is no longer active. Scan again via 🔢 Scanner.
barcode.manual_prompt: ✏️ Type the barcode digits Digits below the barcode, no spaces — e.g. 5449000000996. 8-13 digits. /cancel to abort.
barcode.manual_invalid: Barcode should be 8-13 digits, no letters. Try again 🙂
menu.prompt_intro: 📋 Menu scanner Photograph a café or restaurant menu — I'll extract dishes with calorie estimates. A «Log» button next to each dish adds it to your day. Send a photo now. Or /cancel.
menu.no_dishes: 🤷 Couldn't recognize any dish on this photo. Try a clearer shot, or type the dish.
menu.ocr_failed: ❌ Couldn't process the photo. Try again.
menu.pending_expired: Menu is no longer active. Scan again via /menu.
menu.processing: 🔎 Reading menu… this can take 5-10 seconds.
plan.intro: 🗓 3-day plan I'll build a plan around your calories + health profile. If you want, write what you have at home (e.g. chicken, rice, broccoli, eggs) — I'll factor it in. Or just tap «Without list». /cancel to abort.
plan.failed: ❌ Couldn't generate the plan. Try again in a minute.
plan.pantry_too_long: List is too long — keep it under 200 characters.
fridge.prompt: 🛒 What's in your fridge? List comma-separated — e.g. chicken, rice, broccoli, eggs, tomatoes. I'll suggest a recipe using only those. /cancel to abort.
fridge.too_long: List is too long — keep it under 300 characters.
fridge.variation_hint: Suggest a DIFFERENT recipe than the previous one — different protein (if it was chicken — try fish/eggs/tofu), different cooking method, different spices.
suggest.thinking: 🧠 Thinking up an idea that fits your day…
suggest.failed: Idea got stuck in the model. Try in a minute. 🤖💤
target_weight.ask_lose: 🎯 What weight do you want to lose down to? Write kilograms (e.g. 75):
target_weight.ask_gain: 🎯 What weight do you want to gain up to? Write kilograms (e.g. 80):
target_weight.invalid: Target weight should be 30 to 300 kg. Try again 🙂
target_weight.lose_mismatch: Goal is «lose» but target weight ≥ current ({current} kg). Write a smaller number or change the goal via /profile.
target_weight.gain_mismatch: Goal is «gain» but target weight ≤ current ({current} kg). Write a larger number or change the goal via /profile.
target_weight.cleared: 🎯 «Maintain weight» doesn't need a target — cleared.
